title: AxMap over an existing table
instruction: In the sandbox model, create an AxMap named DemoNoteMap (label + developer documentation @TaxTransactionInquiry:HeaderNote) with two fields: NoteId (String, EDT Num) and Subject (String, EDT Description). Map it to the existing ConDemoNoteHeader table with a 1:1 field mapping (each map field to the table field of the same name). Map ONLY fields the mapped table actually declares. Do NOT add a CreatedDateTime or ModifiedDateTime map field: those names are reserved for D365FO system fields (the compiler rejects them) AND ConDemoNoteHeader declares no such column, so such a field is a reserved-name violation mapping to nothing. The map must build clean.
